descriptions.zh:
一小队来自§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了§Y[Root.GetSpeciesName]§!难民。他们被准许在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
descriptions.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesName]§! refugees from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from their homes by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities. They have been traveling from system to system since then, in a desperate attempt to find new homes before the last of their dwindling supplies were used up.

descriptions.zh:
一小队来自§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的破败民用飞船到达了我们的领域，其中载满了§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!难民。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国肃清的幸存者。多亏了一些紧急召集起来的地面下的一伙和同情他们的商船舰长才逃了出来。
descriptions.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! fleeing from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors from the extermination program being carried out by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities against their species. They only made it out thanks to the efforts of a hastily organized underground railroad and a few sympathetic merchant skippers.

descriptions.zh:
一支的破败民船舰队，满载着逃离§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!，已经抵达了我们的境内。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj]无情攻势下的幸存者。多亏他们冒险从星球上一处旧军港里偷了几艘废弃太空船才逃了出来。
descriptions.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! fleeing from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors of onslaught carried out by the merciless [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj] mind. They only made it out thanks to a daring theft of several decommissioned spacefaring vessels stored in an old naval yard on their planet.

descriptions.zh:
一支伤痕累累的民用小舰队搭载着躲避§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!，刚刚抵达了我们的星系。在我们提供食物与医疗救援之后，避难者们获准在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!上安家。

这些衣衫褴褛而且惊慌不已的避难者们正在躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]星系内的§H[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName]§!的蹂躏。他们勉强在[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj]的攻势抵达其母星§H[RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName]§!之前仓皇逃了出来，将大部分个人财物都留在了那颗注定要覆灭的星球上。
descriptions.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! fleeing from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.

These ragged and frightened refugees are fleeing the ravages of the §H[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName]§! in [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] space. They just barely managed to escape their home planet of §H[RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName]§! before the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj] onslaught reached it, leaving most of their personal possessions behind on the doomed world.
